name: Saved Poster List
description: Visible collection where users browse and manage posters they have saved.
location_context: Saved tab within the main application layout
user_visible_purpose: Let users quickly find and manage their saved posters.

evidence.description: Application router maps the saved tab to SavedPosterList.

notes: User-visible feature; alias mapping improves natural-language lookup for non-technical requests.

name: Poster Detail Availability
description: Poster detail view that remains usable when data availability or sync state changes.
user_visible_purpose: Let users continue viewing or restoring poster details even when availability is uncertain.
user_interactions: See loading or degraded state if sync is pending

evidence.description: During validation, the most plausible explanation for 'missing items after reload' involved availability logic rather than list UI alone.

notes: Confidence is medium because missing-item symptoms can originate from either UI filtering or sync behavior.

name: Browse Home Feed
description: Scrollable home feed that surfaces featured posters and discovery content.
user_visible_purpose: Let users discover new or featured posters without leaving the home experience.

evidence.description: Router exposes the home feed as a top-level tab.
